About me
I am a senior student at the German University in Cairo. I am a software engineer, researcher, and AI enthusiast. I have a passion for learning and exploring new technologies, and I am always looking for opportunities to grow and develop my skills. I have a strong background in software development, with experience in both frontend and backend development, as well as machine learning and control. I am also a physics nerd, with a particular interest in quantum computing and quantum control.

1.title: My Bachelor Project: Feedback GRAPE
1.tagline: Machine Learning Based Optimal Quantum Control
1.description: Optimal Quantum Control aims to find and engineer the optimal control pulses that drive a quantum system from an initial state to a target state, and fields such as quantum computing rely heavily on quantum control techniques to do operations on qubits and control their behavior.

1.title: stock-prices-data-engineering-project
1.description: Built an end-to-end distributed data pipeline that processes stock trading data in real-time into a comprehensive analytics platform.

2.title: Fantasy Premier League Graph-RAG Assistant
2.description: An LLM powered assistant that provides data-driven insights and recommendations for Fantasy Premier League managers using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture.

3.title: Rahhal - Your All-in-One Platform to Travel the World
3.description: In a team of 10, we followed agile methodologies to deliver a comprehensive travel planning platform offering personalized itineraries, seamless bookings, and budget-friendly travel suggestions.

4.title: Java Database Engine with B+ Tree Indexing
4.description: This project entails the development of a database engine utilizing Java within a Maven project framework. The database engine facilitates CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations while minimizing SQL query execution time through the implementation of indexing on pertinent columns using the B+ tree data structure.

5.title: Operating System Simulator
5.description: An OS simulator, utilizing Multi-Level-Feedback-Queues (MLFQ) for efficient process scheduling and mutexes for resource management , ensuring concurrency.

6.title: feedback-grape
6.description: feedback-grape is a high-performance Python package for simulating and optimizing quantum systems with feedback. It builds on the GRAPE (Gradient Ascent Pulse Engineering) method and introduces a new approach that integrates feedback in a natural, differentiable, and efficient way.
